also: there is a certain pleasure in weeping

evidence: Ov. Tr. 4.3.37: aequē meōs cāsūs: est quaedam flēre voluptās
terms.comment: Literally “there is a certain pleasure in weeping”: Ovid from exile, to his wife.
Traupman’s prose order of Ovid’s half-line.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Ovid, Tristia 4.3.37, quoted from the Perseus Latin texts; the line is not in Lewis & Short or the loci collections and has not been checked against them.
